item.title: Why Markets Are Buoyant — and Under Pressure
item.description: Energy and technology companies’ earnings are expected to keep driving up stock indexes. But what’s driving up their profits are weighing on the economy.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Ross Sorkin, Bernhard Warner, Sarah Kessler, Michael J. de la Merced, Niko Gallogly, Brian O’Keefe, Sri Muppidi, Lauren Hirsch and Ian Mount
item.media:description: Analysts expect stock prices to keep rising. But worries about risks to the economy keep growing, too.

item.title: Tishman Speyer Takes Over Chrysler Building With Big Renovation Plans
item.description: A large commercial landlord is planning to spruce up the office spaces and add amenities after the building lost its luster in recent years.

item.media:description: Built in 1930, the Chrysler Building “is a building that every New Yorker feels like they own,” said Rob Speyer, the chief executive of Tishman Speyer.

item.title: Europe’s Trade Tensions With China Are Coming to a Head
item.description: The European Union is weighing tougher trade measures as negotiators prepare to meet Chinese officials in Beijing, with surging exports from China pressuring key industries in Europe.

item.title: China’s ‘Self-Reliance’ Drive Is Upending Trade With Europe
item.description: China’s push to manufacture more at home has widened its trade imbalance with Europe, intensifying pressure on European industries and policymakers to take action.

item.media:credit: Felix Schmitt for The New York Times
item.media:description: A car from BYD, China’s largest electric-vehicle maker, at an auto show in Munich last year.

item.title: Airfares Have Spiked. Is the Death of Spirit Airlines to Blame?
item.description: In the wake of the ultra-low-cost carrier’s closure, and with the cost of fuel and labor rising, domestic fares have become less competitive. But there are ways to parry higher prices.
item.dc:creator: Elaine Glusac
item.media:description: Spirit Airlines planes parked at the Phoenix Goodyear Airport in Goodyear, Ariz., in May, a few days after the airline ceased operations.

item.title: Inheritances Can Shatter Families. Could a Therapist Help?

item.title: Need Help Paying for College? Try Bass Fishing.

item.title: Paramount Closes Merger With Warner Bros. Discovery to Form Skydance
